title: Scalar/pullback binary tensor compatibility
statement:
Let \(A,B\) be commutative rings, \(\varphi:A\to B\) a unital map, and \(f:X\to Y\) a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Use the ordinary unbounded derived small-etale module categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Let \(Q_T\), \(d_{Q_T}\) be normalized scalar extension and its tensor comparison [def-pur-exceptional-coefficient-normalizations], \(L_R=Lf_R^*\) geometric derived pullback with tensor comparison \(d_{L_R}\), and \(a:Q_Y;L_B\simeq L_A;Q_X\) the canonical scalar/pullback comparison [lem-pur-etale-scalar-mate-projection] fixed by the ordinary representative data [def-pur-scalar-pullback-representative-data]. For every \(P,Q\in D(Y_{\mathrm{et}},A)\),
\[
a_{P\otimes Q};Q_X(d_{L_A}(P,Q));d_{Q_X}(L_AP,L_AQ)
= L_B(d_{Q_Y}(P,Q));d_{L_B}(Q_YP,Q_YQ);(a_P\otimes a_Q).
\]
Semicolon denotes composition in application order, and all tensor comparisons point from the functor of a tensor to the tensor of the two images. No finiteness, properness, flatness, or boundedness assumptions are imposed. The predicate ScalarPullbackTensorLaw is precisely this binary equation with the four monoidal categories and comparison maps shared.

proof.text: Choose flat K-flat representatives for both inputs. Their tensor and geometric pullbacks remain flat K-flat. Scalar extension is ordinary scalar extension on these representatives. Substitute the defining scalar/pullback representative square and the scalar and geometric tensor representative squares. The ordinary coefficient/pullback chain square sends both homogeneous local tensor generators ((p tensor q) tensor b) to (f*p tensor b) tensor (f*q tensor 1); balancing moves b between the two factors. Both maps have the same total-complex summands, differentials and Koszul signs. Sheafification preserves this equality. Cancel the invertible representative arrows. Naturality and K-flat resolutions in both variables give the equality on all derived inputs.

theorem etaleScalarPullback_tensor
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (φ : A →+* B)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    ScalarPullbackTensorLaw (scalarExtension φ Y) (scalarExtension φ X)
      (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).leftDerivedFunctor
      (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) f).leftDerivedFunctor
      (scalarPullbackIso φ f) (ExceptionalCoefficients.tensorIso φ Y)
      (ExceptionalCoefficients.tensorIso φ X)
      (leftDerivedUpperStarTensorIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f)
      (leftDerivedUpperStarTensorIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) f)
